title_zh: 时间旅行：无法改变的过去
reveal_en: If time travel were possible, you couldn't actually change historical events. Any attempt to alter the past would paradoxically result in an outcome that maintains the original timeline you experienced.
reveal_zh: 即使时间旅行可行，你仍无法改变历史事件。任何试图更改过去的尝试，都会以一种吊诡的方式，维持你所经历的原始时间线。
meaning_en: This suggests the past is unalterable, even if traversable, re-framing traditional time paradoxes.
meaning_zh: 这表明即使过去可被穿越，它也是无法改变的，重构了传统的时间悖论。

visual.motion: A chronological flow of light, briefly fragmenting, then re-coalescing.
